title: Singapore's Approach towards Housing of Transgender Persons in Prison Settings
what_it_is: Singapore's Approach towards Housing of Transgender Persons in Prison Settings

sections.label: Housing inmates by registered sex
sections.summary: Inmates are housed by registered sex, with individual or shared cells used where safety requires, and medical assessment can update registered sex.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: In Singapore, our primary consideration is the safety of the inmates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: As a rule, inmates are housed in a male or female institution based on their registered sex, and not their self-identified gender.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: There may be situations, however, where it may be better not to house an inmate with other inmates of their registered sex for consideration of safety, either for the safety of the inmate or the safety of the other inmates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: On the other hand, inmates in a female institution may not feel comfortable if we house with them, a former male who has just completed transitioning to be a female, especially if, like in the case of Bryson, the person had previously committed sexual offences.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: So, in such cases, we may house them alone in individual cells within the institution of their registered sex, or in a shared cell with other inmates who are in the same situation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: In such cases, Prisons may first house them alone in individual cells in the institution of their registered sex.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: Prisons will then facilitate an examination by a medical specialist to assess if they have had a complete physical change in genitalia, and if so, will assist the inmate to update their registered sex with the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA).

sections.label: Low violence in Prisons
sections.summary: Violence in Prisons is very low due to pre-emptive measures and tight discipline.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: In general, the level of violence in our Prisons is very low, both because of pre-emptive measures and the discipline in the Prisons – fairly tight control is exercised.

sections.label: Counselling for all inmates
sections.summary: Counsellors are available and inmates are interviewed regularly so they can raise issues for consideration.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: Not just for transgender persons but all inmates – there is an approach as part of the rehabilitation process – where counsellors are available, and prisoners are interviewed regularly and spoken with, and where inmates are able to raise the issues they have and they will be considered.
